description: This file contains definitions and configurations for building firmware images for various devices using the Linux build system. It includes device-specific build instructions, image preparation steps, and metadata for numerous device profiles, mainly for network equipment and routers.

methods.name: Image/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the firmware image, e.g., for UBI, by creating a marker file.

methods.name: Build/append-netis-n6-metadata
methods.description: Builds and appends metadata specific to Netis-N6 supported devices.

methods.name: Build/arcadyan-trx
methods.description: Creates a special firmware image for Arcadyan devices with magic and headers.

methods.name: Build/inteno-y3-header
methods.description: Generates a header for Inteno Y3 devices, with device-specific info.

methods.name: Build/inteno-bootfs
methods.description: Builds a UBIFS filesystem image with kernel and kernel image for Inteno.

methods.name: Build/gemtek-trailer
methods.description: Creates a trailer for Gemtek devices, e.g., for checksum purposes.

methods.name: Build/h3c-blank-header
methods.description: Creates a blank header for H3C devices.

methods.name: Build/haier-sim_wr1800k-factory
methods.description: Generates factory image for Haier devices including hashing.

methods.name: Build/iodata-mstc-header
methods.description: Creates headers for I-O Data devices, involving checksums.

methods.name: Build/iodata-mstc-header2
methods.description: Creates an extended header with device and firmware info for I-O Data.

methods.name: Build/znet-header
methods.description: Creates a custom header for ZNET devices with version and CRC info.

methods.name: Build/belkin-header
methods.description: Creates Belkin-specific headers for firmware images.

methods.name: Build/zyxel-nwa-fit
methods.description: Builds a header for Zyxel NWA-fit firmware images.
